    Student activity budget

    Student activity budget for Tha Prachan by fiscal year: the full FY 2569 bulletin and the FY 2568 figures that exist.

    Published by
    Thammasat University Student Council, Tha Prachan (TUSC)
    Last updated
    31 October 2026
    Next update
    To be announced
    Contact
    TUSC secretariat team, Tha Prachan [shared address to be confirmed]

    Fiscal years

    Table 1: Fiscal years with figures
    Fiscal yearTotal (baht)What is published
    FY 2569 (2026)1,988,223.24Full bulletin: 4 figures, tables and CSV
    FY 2568 (2025)1,970,599.50Organisation table, 10 lines

    Source: Report - Summary of Student Activity Budget Report, Fiscal Year 2026 (B.E. 2569)

    Fiscal year 2569

    Total 1,988,223.24 baht, with 58.9% to the Student Union, as printed in the report. The full bulletin has 4 figures, and tables for the council and every club.

    • Student activity budget, Tha Prachan: fiscal year 2569 (2026), HTML and 4 CSV files download,

      • Statistical bulletin
      • 19 March 2026
      • HTML and 4 CSV files

    Fiscal year 2568

    FY 2568 has no report of its own. The only figures are an organisation table on page 16 of the FY 2569 report, which prints a total of 1,970,599.50 baht. Figure 3 of the FY 2569 bulletin shows both years.

    Table 2: Budget by organisation, fiscal year 2568 (baht)
    OrganisationBudget (baht)Share of total (%)
    Student Union (TUSU)1,248,164.5063.3
    ASA TPC volunteer club340,000.0017.3
    TPC MUSIC club281,890.0014.3
    TU HOST club49,176.002.5
    TU TPC FC football and futsal independent group15,000.000.8
    Student Council (TUSC)9,472.000.5
    TPC DANCE club9,195.00[not stated]
    TU DOC documentary studies independent group7,850.000.4
    TEDC English public speaking club5,200.000.3
    Election Commission (กกต.)4,652.000.2
    Total1,970,599.50[not stated]

    Source: Report - Summary of Student Activity Budget Report, Fiscal Year 2026 (B.E. 2569), page 16

    1. Sorted by amount.
    2. FY 2568 has no project or category lines and no report of its own. The figures come from page 16 of the FY 2569 report.
    3. Shares are the percentages printed on the report's pie chart. [not stated] means the report does not give the figure.
